title: PLC0414 useless-import-alias: detect in *.pyi files - mypy stubgen generates the violation
body:
### Summary

mypy's stubgen generates import alias violations:

```python
from ldap._types import LDAPEntryDict as LDAPEntryDict
from ldap.cidict import cidict as cidict
from ldap.schema.subentry import SCHEMA_ATTR_MAPPING as SCHEMA_ATTR_MAPPING, SCHEMA_CLASS_MAPPING as SCHEMA_CLASS_MAPPING
from ldap.schema.tokenizer import (
    LDAPTokenDict as LDAPTokenDict,
    LDAPTokenDictValue as LDAPTokenDictValue,
    parse_tokens as parse_tokens,
    split_tokens as split_tokens,
)
```
ruff only detects them in py file, not in pyi files:
```
$ cp models.pyi models.py
$ ruff check --select useless-import-alias models.pyi
All checks passed!
$ ruff check --select useless-import-alias models.py
models.py:1:25: useless-import-alias: [*] Import alias does not rename original package
models.py:2:25: useless-import-alias: [*] Import alias does not rename original package
models.py:3:34: useless-import-alias: [*] Import alias does not rename original package
models.py:3:78: useless-import-alias: [*] Import alias does not rename original package
models.py:5:5: useless-import-alias: [*] Import alias does not rename original package
models.py:6:5: useless-import-alias: [*] Import alias does not rename original package
models.py:7:5: useless-import-alias: [*] Import alias does not rename original package
models.py:8:5: useless-import-alias: [*] Import alias does not rename original package
Found 8 errors.
[*] 8 fixable with the `--fix` option.
```

→ Please add support for .pyi files.

### Version

0.16.9
